name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: Inbound leads go cold fast, and the rep who responds first with a relevant question usually wins the meeting. I've been that rep for most of my career. I spent four years as a BDR booking sales-ready meetings, then sold SaaS: up to 10 deals a month on up to 150 calls a day at Fivestars, top three on a team of 8 to 15 at Accelo while quota roughly doubled (~$213K a year in services bookings), 120% of sales target at Wix, and ~$130K+ in bookings from 6 deals at Fetch & Funnel.

I've also built the other side of the process. At my consulting business, Solenzo, I design automated lead capture, routing, and follow-up systems so no inbound lead waits for a response, and at Level Agency I reported on which campaigns actually produced quality leads. That makes me a useful partner to marketing when it comes to feedback on lead quality. I've worked in Salesforce at Birdeye, Wix, and Fivestars, and have used HubSpot, ZoomInfo, Salesloft, and Apollo.
I'm based in Arvada, so the Denver office is close if hybrid works better for the team. I'd welcome a conversation at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
